issues.title: Rejected lookups stay cached for 60 seconds
issues.explanation: The promise is cached before it settles and nothing removes it on failure. One pricing timeout makes every request for that SKU fail for a full minute, which CAT-58 forbids.
issues.fix: Attach promise.catch(() => cache.delete(sku)) (only if the entry is still this promise) before returning.

issues.title: Result order and length no longer match the input
issues.explanation: Object.values orders integer-like keys numerically, so numeric SKUs come back sorted, not in input order, and a duplicated SKU collapses to one entry. Callers zip by index and will show the wrong price on the wrong item.
issues.fix: Keep the old shape: return Promise.all(skus.map(lookupCached)).

issues.title: Expired entries are never evicted
issues.explanation: Entries are only replaced when the same SKU is asked for again, so the map grows with every SKU ever priced.
issues.fix: Delete expired entries on read, or use a bounded LRU/TTL cache.
